correctness.rationale: Definitions fix the graph, open-neighborhood complex, G-action and two rational summands U, eta, J. Exact face vector and mod-two boundary ranks are reproduced by a standalone exhaustive program, giving rational homology concentrated in degree 3 and rank 35 by Euler characteristic. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces of all 136 affine elements yield the asserted character. The character of \(2U\oplus\eta\oplus J\) agrees class by class; Maschke semisimplicity identifies the \(\mathbb Q[G]\) module. No rational-from-finite-to-infinite inference or integral-lattice assertion is made.

value.rationale: The 35-dimensional affine symmetry action on a canonical Paley neighborhood complex had not been determined by the known Moore-plus-spheres homotopy type. The result gives an exact natural rational-module decomposition including an exceptional 3-dimensional complement, and computes 3 translation invariants versus 0 full affine invariants; it is a motivated complete classification of a nontrivial group action rather than a repetition of the Betti number.
